results.question: what is the doctrine of three steps
results.reply: The [Doctrine of Three Steps] is the rule governing the Measure of Standing for samurai of different ranks. It determines appropriate conduct for interactions such as duels, arrests, and the exchange of gifts. You can find the full explanation of how it governs your authority and social standing on the campaign wiki.

results.question: how far does a blood feud reach?
results.reply: A blood feud extends to every descendant of each named person's paternal great-grandfather on both sides. Any of these individuals may lawfully kill any on the other side.

results.question: what was the family reckoning?
results.reply: The Family Reckoning was a messy all-hands Wasp job involving the delivery of an Imperial summons to [Ikoma Yuan](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-yuan) at a teahouse. The event resulted in the death of the Lion shugenja [Ikoma Tsai](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-tsai). His relatives - [Ikoma Wataemon](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-wataemon), [Ikoma Naohira](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-naohira), and [Ikoma Ietsugu](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-ietsugu) - subsequently declared a blood feud against the Wasp marshals present. This event is the source of the [Righteous Sting](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/custom-advantages-and-disadvantages) and [Venomous Sting](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/custom-advantages-and-disadvantages) campaign advantages and disadvantages.

results.question: what does righteous sting mean?
results.reply: Righteous Sting is a custom advantage in our campaign related to The Family Reckoning. It signifies that your relative at the teahouse acted honorably during that event. Mechanically, it allows your Rank to count higher, and it also increases the party's Rank.

results.question: what does the peasantborn disadvantage do
results.reply: The Peasantborn disadvantage means you are the child of a peasant whom [Tsuruchi](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi) raised to the samurai caste. Because of this, you are never considered to be of peer standing with samurai-born characters.

results.question: what's the difference between rolled and kept dice?
results.reply:
In a roll written as XkY, X is the number of dice you roll, and Y is the number of dice you keep to sum for your total.
You roll all X dice, then choose the Y highest results to add together.
A 10 on any die is rerolled and added to that die's total.
No roll may use more than 10 dice; extra rolled dice become kept dice, and each die beyond 10k10 adds +1 to the total.

results.question: what does a feint do?
results.reply: A feint is an attack roll made in place of your normal attack skill that does no damage. If successful, it grants you a temporary void point and moves your highest action die to the current phase.

results.question: how many void points can i spend on a roll?
results.reply: You may spend no more void points on a single roll than your lowest Ring.

results.question: how is my dan determined?

results.question: what was the day of thunder?
results.reply: The Day of Thunder (1123) was a cataclysmic event in which a cult of Lord Moon attempted a coup against the Emperor's authority. The Seven Thunders defeated the cultist Shinjo Jotsu, but the cultist Jama no Iuchiban Kohaku slew the remaining Thunders. Since then, it is heretical to pray to Lord Moon inside a temple consecrated to Lady Sun.
